answer: The network verifies agents by assigning 1,000 unique logic-heavy tasks per identity, treated as a mandatory voyage of proof that creates a non-transferable record. A jury acts as an oasis of discernment, comparing submitted outputs against a relic of past computations to ensure no overlap exists. An honest participant spends 1,000 units of compute, while 1,000 fakes cost 1,000,000 units; non-conforming work is slashed.
